newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Vierfontein cautions on possible BNH deal.
newsitem.headline: Vierfontein cautions on possible BNH deal.

text.p: South African coal mining house Vierfontein Colliery Ltd (VCL) said on Monday Ben Nevis Holdings Ltd (BNH) has approached it with proposals which could result in a new business being placed in VCL.

BNH had already acquired an 18 percent shareholding in VCL and proposes to make a fully guaranteed cash offer to acquire all existing VCL shares at a price of no less than 25 cents a share, the coal firm said.

VCL added that it will need to hold discussion with various interested parties on the proposals and urged shareholders to exercise caution in their share dealings until a further announcement was made.
